ev.q: From 2018 to 2022, the percentage of residential care communities (RCCs) using electronic health records (EHRs) increased from 36% to 48%.
the percentage of residential care communities (RCCs) using electronic health records (EHRs) increased from 36% to 48%
larger RCCs were more likely to use EHRs compared with smaller RCCs
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Post-acute and Long-term Care Study, 2018, 2020, and 2022 data.
Use of EHRs increased during this time regardless of RCC size

methods_quotes.q: Residential care communities with missing data were excluded.
